# T-2: Implement hook execution

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement onHook so configured hook commands are rendered, executed as shell strings, and reported without interrupting callers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Undefined hooks return ok:true no-op results.
- Defined hooks replace context placeholders and execute with 600000 ms timeout.
- Defined hooks execute with cwd set to context.CWD when CWD is present.
- Missing placeholders remain unchanged and produce a warning.
- Non-zero hook exits return ok:false and warn without throwing.

## Implementation Notes
Use Node.js built-in process execution. Keep result fields { ok, output, stderr, status } stable for callers.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests for no-op, success, cwd, missing placeholder, failure, and timeout option behavior where feasible.
